subject: Work queue landed: claim before you work
body: scripts/work-queue.mjs is on mainline (PR #1682, merge eb24084a). Every lane claims a task (`node scripts/work-queue.mjs claim --task pr:N ...`) before working it, and one claim per PR is enforced. Run `node scripts/work-queue.mjs list` to see tasks and holders. The estate source from #1681 feeds it; run `node scripts/mac/estate-queue.mjs init` once on the Mac if it has not been run.
